P01.drivers: Average proportions, normal shoulder-waist-hip taper, normal lumbar curve and buttock in profile, straight legs

P02.drivers: Average build with slight soft belly; ordinary taper and profile

P03.drivers: Mildly overweight: rounded belly in profile, slightly thicker waist, otherwise human proportions

P04.drivers: Trunk is a flat-sided rectangular block from shoulders to hips with no waist; profile back is an almost vertical flat plane; trunk overhangs thighs with an abrupt shelf at the hip; thick cylindrical legs; arms comparatively slim and short relative to the slab trunk

P05.drivers: Narrow wasp waist, long arms with hands reaching mid-thigh and elbows bowed outward; profile shows strong S-curve: chest thrust forward, deep back curve, slightly forward/bent knee with posterior calf bulge

P06.drivers: Lean/athletic human, broad-ish shoulders, normal taper and profile

P08.drivers: Barrel trunk very wide and deep with rounded back and belly in profile, little waist, trunk overhanging thighs with a hip shelf; legs comparatively narrow below; similar trunk organization to P04. Could alternatively be an obese human (B, fatness)

P10.drivers: Same pattern as P05: narrow waist, long arms with bowed elbows, profile with forward chest, curved back, flexed knee and bulging posterior thigh/calf

P11.drivers: Lean, slightly long-legged human, normal profile

groups.label: Ordinary humans (average to lean/athletic, some mildly soft)
Block/barrel-trunk bodies: no waist, flat or rounded deep trunk overhanging thick legs
Wasp-waisted, long-armed, S-curved bodies with flexed knees

distinguishing_features: P04/P08 are wide and heavy, with a slab or barrel trunk, no waist, an abrupt trunk-to-thigh shelf, thick legs and comparatively short arms, and they stand upright. P05/P10 are narrow-waisted and light, with long bowed arms, a forward chest, a strong spinal S-curve and flexed knees with bulging calves and thighs. P08 is the least certain: it could be an obese human.
